properties.name: Mount Ararat (Traditional Site)
properties.description: Greater Ararat (Agri Dagi) at 16,854 ft is the traditional identification. Turkish mountain near Armenian border.
properties.debate: The text says 'mountains of Ararat' (plural) - a region, not necessarily this specific peak.

properties.name: Durupinar Site
properties.description: A boat-shaped formation 18 miles south of Ararat. Some claim it matches ark dimensions; others say it's geological.
properties.debate: Ron Wyatt promoted this site. Scientific analysis inconclusive - could be geological formation or buried structure.

properties.name: Mountains of Ararat Region (Urartu)
properties.description: Ararat refers to the ancient kingdom of Urartu in the Armenian highlands, not a single peak.
properties.archaeology: Urartu was a known kingdom in Assyrian records. The Armenian highlands contain many mountains where the ark could have landed.

properties.name: Raven's Flight
properties.description: After 40 days, Noah opened the window and sent out a raven. It flew back and forth until waters dried.

properties.name: Olive Branch (Dove Return)
properties.description: The dove returned with an olive leaf, showing vegetation had emerged. Symbol of peace and new beginning.
properties.archaeology: Olive trees grow in the Ararat region, consistent with the dove finding vegetation nearby.
